title: Refine confidence: 0.5 means not sure, evidence required above 0.7; the refiner run on past days

chat.text: One scale, written once: a confidence is a probability, 0.5 is the default and means not sure, anything above 0.7 needs its evidence named beside it, and the UI labels the number so 0.9 can never read as "pretty high" when the system meant "slightly below default". The scorer changes to match; old scores are shown as old scale. Then a Haiku script runs the refiner on each past day's prompts in reverse, with ten spot-checks.
